content: Hey beautiful, how was your day? I was thinking about you all afternoon.
Hi! My day was alright, just work and then came home. It always cheers me up to hear from you.
That means so much to me. I honestly can't wait for the day we can finally meet in person. I feel like I've known you forever.
Me too. It's been a long time since I've had someone to talk to like this. I look forward to your messages every day.
You make me feel so lucky. I wish I could hug you right now. I have something on my mind though... I hope you don't mind me sharing.
Of course, you can tell me anything. What's going on?
I'm so embarrassed, but I really need your help. My mom had an accident and is in the hospital, and my bank account is temporarily frozen because of a mistake. I don't know who else to turn to.
Oh no, that's terrible! Is she going to be alright? How can I help?
Thank you for caring, sweetheart. She's stable now, but the hospital requires a deposit for her treatment. If you could send $500, I'll pay you right back as soon as my account is fixed.
That's a lot of money, but I want to help if I can. How do I send it to you?
You're amazing. The quickest way is through Zelle, do you have the app? If so, you can send it to my email: michael_holmes88@mail.com.
I have Zelle, yes. Just to be sure, this is really your email, right? I just want to help you, but I've been told to be careful online.
I understand, and I appreciate that you're cautious. I promise, it's really me. You know I'd never do anything to hurt you. You'll get your money back as soon as possible.
Alright, I trust you. I'll try sending it now. Let me know once you get it, okay?
Thank you, love. You have no idea how much this means to me. I'll watch for the notification and let you know immediately.
Just sent it! I really hope your mom gets better soon. Keep me updated, please.
I just received it. You're a lifesaver. My mom will get the care she needs, all thanks to you. I owe you everything.
I'm just glad I could help. Let me know if you need anything else, okay?
You're so generous. I'll never forget this kindness. I can't wait to hold you in my arms someday soon.
